description: Fires most strongly when the player to move has three of their own stones in a row horizontally in columns 3-5 (any row above the bottom) and the cell in column 6 at the end of that row is empty, so column 6 holds their threat, and the opponent has no threat right under it. Weaker firing on many other threat patterns, including positions where the opponent has two immediate wins. The opponent's own three does not trigger it.
effect: Raises the probability of playing column 6: forcing it to max added +0.18 to +0.83 to column 6 on three positions; zeroing it in a top example cut column 6 (the winning move) from 0.51 to 0.28.
notes: Best dev F1 0.283 (P 0.31, R 0.26, AUROC 0.62), sim share 0.20 (p5). The top band is consistent (my XXX in cols 3-5 aiming at column 6, side to move only). Most firing below band 8 is other threat shapes with column-specific, context-dependent behaviour (row-0 open threes at cols 2-4 of either colour; opponent stone above the three's middle suppresses it). Broader rules (any col-6 threat, any horizontal threat) lose precision. It may be a mixture or partly random direction. Synthesis best 29.47 vs dev max 29.69.
